_description: Initial cash balance well above maxMonths × monthly — verifies immediate sweep to Taxable on year 0.
_rationale: Cash $500k starting balance. Spending $40k/yr. Policy min=6, target=12, max=18, refillTrigger='gains_only'. monthly = $40k/12 ≈ $3,333. maxCash = 18 × $3,333 ≈ $60,000. Cash $500k >> maxCash → sweep $440k to Taxable in year 0 post-convergence. Year 0 ending cash should equal maxCash (~$60k). No Taxable account exists initially → ensureReinvestmentAccount creates synthetic Reinvestment-Taxable receiving the sweep. Sweep is tax-free (no LTCG generated).
name: Bucket Max Sweep
